Container.Name: ha-edu-portal
Container.Overview:
Educational Portal for Home Assistant - A web-based portal for managing multiple Home Assistant demo instances for educational purposes. Perfect for classroom environments where students need their own isolated Home Assistant instances.
Features: - Easy instance creation with web interface - Password protected instances - Admin password for managing all instances - Instance reset functionality - Automatic port assignment - Network isolation with internet access - Cloudflare tunnel ready
Access the portal at http://[IP]:[PORT:5000]

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing the HA-Edu portal web interface

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for managing Home Assistant containers. Required for creating and managing instances.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for storing instance data and configuration

Config.Name: Base Port
Config.Description: Starting port number for Home Assistant instances. Ports are assigned dynamically starting from this value.

Config.Name: Data File Path
Config.Description: Path to store instance data within the container. Usually does not need to be changed.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Image
Config.Description: Home Assistant Docker image to use for instances. Change to use a specific version or different image.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Admin password for reset functionality. If not set, reset buttons will be hidden. Leave empty to disable admin features. If enabling, use a strong password (recommended: 12+ characters with mix of letters, numbers, and symbols).
